name: slurp
title: Slurp
description: A noodle-bar theme built round the meal-ticket machine by the door: under a vermilion header strip the menu is a charcoal enamel fascia of square, black-framed lit keys — yellow, pink, pale green or white by section, a lamp in the corner and the price on the foot strip of each — over a pay bar with coin slot, note slot and ticket tray. The room is charcoal, or cream in the light scheme; each dish's own page is its printed ticket.

tokens.--font-sans: all running text: site title, headings, key names and descriptions, body text, labels, the button
tokens.--font-mono: anything with a figure in it: prices, hours-card values, dates, phone numbers, the ticket's section line, the full-menu ticket, pagination, tags and code
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the small capital labels: menu links, section names on keys and tickets, hours-card labels, the button, dates, tags, table headings, the panel label
tokens.--color-bg: page background — the wall the machine stands against — and the bites along the torn foot of a ticket
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, the name in the footer and tag labels
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: hours-card labels, dates, post summaries, table headings, blockquotes, pagination, the empty-menu message and the footer
tokens.--color-accent: links in text, a post title on hover, and the frame of a tag on hover
tokens.--color-strip: the vermilion header strip, the button, a key while it is pressed (hover), the lettering of the current menu link, the small square before each h2, the blockquote bar and selected text
tokens.--color-strip-ink: text on the header strip, on the button, on a pressed key and in selected text; the frame of the menu links and the face of the current one
tokens.--color-well: background of the footer and of code
tokens.--color-rule: thin lines: between hours-card rows, between posts, in tables, round code blocks and tags, and the dashed hr
tokens.--color-rim: the black frame round every key, the panel, the hours card and the button; the line under the header strip and over the footer; the ring of a pressed key's lamp; the dark band either side of the focus ring
tokens.--color-focus: the lit ring round whatever has keyboard focus
tokens.--color-panel: the machine's fascia: the field the keys sit in. Charcoal in both schemes, so the keys look lit
tokens.--panel-ink: lettering and fittings on the fascia: the panel label and the rims of the coin and note slots
tokens.--panel-rule: thin lines on the fascia: beside the panel label and round the pay bar
tokens.--panel-slot: the pay bar under the keys, which holds the coin slot, the note slot and the ticket tray
tokens.--key-yellow: face of the keys for meals (Breakfast, Mains), the band on their tickets, the lamp of a pressed key, and the lit slits of the coin and note slots
tokens.--key-pink: face of the keys for bakes and sweets (Bread, Pastries, Desserts), and the band on their tickets
tokens.--key-green: face of the keys for small plates (Starters, Sides, Snacks), and the band on their tickets
tokens.--key-white: face of every other key (Hot drinks, Drinks, an item with no section), and the band on their tickets
tokens.--key-ink: lettering on the keys, and the ring round each key's lamp
tokens.--key-foot: the shade laid over the foot strip of a key, behind its section name and price
tokens.--key-lamp: the small lit lamp in the corner of each key
tokens.--key-shadow: the hard edge under each key and under the button, the highlight along their top, and the glow lit keys throw on the fascia
tokens.--ticket-paper: paper of the ticket: a menu item's own page, the 404, the full-menu ticket in the pay bar, and the skip link
tokens.--ticket-ink: print on that paper, and the dashed tear lines of a ticket
tokens.--page-width: widest the header strip, the page and the footer grow
tokens.--side: width of the left column on wide screens (page titles; on the home page, the text beside the panel) and the widest a ticket grows
tokens.--measure: widest the text column grows: body text, post lists, cover images, tables
tokens.--gutter: space between the page and the edge of the screen
tokens.--key-min: narrowest a key may be on screens wider than a phone — the panel fits as many across as this allows; keys are square, so this is also about how tall they stand
tokens.--key-gap: gap between keys, and between the menu links in the strip
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of keys, the button, the hours card, the pay bar and its note slot, menu links, tags, code and images; the panel's is twice this
tokens.--rim: weight of the frames round keys, panel, hours card, button, menu links and the coin and note slots, of the lines under the strip and over the footer, and of the dashed lines (hr, ticket tear lines)
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: between tags, above a post summary, beside the panel label; also the width of the blockquote bar
tokens.--space-2: small gap: padding of the panel, the strip and the pay bar, under headings, above dates
tokens.--space-3: gap between paragraphs and blocks, padding of the hours card, the ticket and code blocks
tokens.--space-4: large gap: above headings in text, between the two columns, above and below the page, under the panel on a phone
